name: A 580-Concept Cornerless Class with a One-Corner Forbidden Minor
statement: There is a 580-concept ample class in $Q_{24}$ of VC dimension three and minimum graph degree four that is cornerless and whose every nonempty proper pc-minor has a corner. Its unique forbidden pc-minor has 292 concepts and exactly one corner. Hence pc-minimality among cornerless ample classes is strictly weaker than being a cornerless forbidden pc-minor, even for graph three-cores of VC dimension three.
proof: Translate the verified 292-concept one-corner obstruction and the verified 289-concept one-corner peelable rooted factor so their distinguished corners are zero, then wedge them on disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks. The gluing theorem gives all-minor and uniqueness statements. The checker reconstructs both inputs, verifies their shadows and corners, 48 rooted orders, 36 ordinary proper-minor orders, the order and VC dimension of the wedge, its minimum degree and cornerlessness, and all 72 elementary images.
